import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    Mod = 1000000007

    class Matrix:
        def __init__(self, size):
            self.size = size
            self.a = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]

        def unit(self):
            for i in range(self.size):
                self.a[i][i] = 1

        def out(self):
            for i in range(self.size):
                print(' '.join(str(self.a[i][j]) for j in range(self.size)))
            print()

        def __mul__(self, other):
            res = Matrix(self.size)
            for i in range(self.size):
                for k in range(self.size):
                    if self.a[i][k]:
                        for j in range(self.size):
                            res.a[i][j] = (res.a[i][j] + self.a[i][k] * other.a[k][j]) % Mod
            return res

    def id_func(x, step):
        return x if x > k else ((x + step - 1) % k + 1)

    def move(base, step):
        step %= k
        res = Matrix(k + 1)
        for i in range(1, k + 2):
            for j in range(1, k + 2):
                res.a[id_func(i, step) - 1][id_func(j, step) - 1] = base.a[i - 1][j - 1]
        return res

    A = [Matrix(k + 1) for _ in range(k + 2)]
    ans = [0] * (k + 2)

    A[0].unit()
    A[0].a[0][i] = 1 for i in range(k + 1)

    V = []
    temp_n = n
    len_idx = 0
    while temp_n:
        V.append(temp_n % k)
        temp_n //= k
        len_idx += 1

        A[len_idx] = Matrix(k + 1)
        A[len_idx].unit()

        x = A[len_idx - 1]
        power = k
        p = 0
        while power:
            if power & 1:
                A[len_idx] = A[len_idx] * move(x, (power ^ 1) << p)
            x = move(x, 1 << p) * x
            p += 1
            power >>= 1

    step = 0
    ans[k + 1] = 1

    for T in range(len(V) - 1, -1, -1):
        cur = V[T]
        if cur:
            tmp = [0] * (k + 2)
            for times in range(cur):
                for i in range(1, k + 2):
                    tmp[i] = ans[i]
                    ans[i] = 0
                B = move(A[T], times + step)
                for i in range(1, k + 2):
                    for j in range(1, k + 2):
                        ans[i] = (ans[i] + tmp[j] * B.a[i - 1][j - 1]) % Mod
        step += cur

    res = 0
    for i in range(1, k + 2):
        res = (res + ans[i]) % Mod
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
